recommendation: Keep this source fix as-is. No further core follow-up is needed for FHIR-13562 unless generated output later diverges from the corrected source; the fhir.ini DiagnosticReport.image alias should remain as compatibility mapping.
issue_request: FHIR-13562 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request raised for STU3. It said DiagnosticReport.image and its description incorrectly implied a single still image even though Media could represent broader content, and the accepted resolution was to rename DiagnosticReport.image to DiagnosticReport.media.
initial_application: The rename was initially applied in Jira-tagged commit 17a86882a2828780d4c4f2bd3155b8434c7af17f, which changed DiagnosticReport spreadsheet element names and the ultrasound example from image to media. Later refactors moved the active source into structuredefinition-DiagnosticReport.xml and bundle-DiagnosticReport-search-params.xml, with source/fhir.ini retaining DiagnosticReport.image only as a legacy alias to DiagnosticReport.media.
additional_context: DiagnosticReport is active in source/fhir.ini. The current StructureDefinition already uses DiagnosticReport.media and image-or-data wording for media, media.comment, and media.link, including later FHIR-34068 broadening. A related FHIR-33105 audit on the combined branch confirmed other stale image/imaging element wording had been reconciled. The remaining in-build mismatch was SearchParameter/DiagnosticReport-media still describing only an image source.
reconciliation: Changed source/diagnosticreport/bundle-DiagnosticReport-search-params.xml so SearchParameter/DiagnosticReport-media now says "A reference to the image or data source." This keeps the active search parameter surface aligned with DiagnosticReport.media.link.
source_changes: source/diagnosticreport/bundle-DiagnosticReport-search-params.xml: changed SearchParameter/DiagnosticReport-media description from "A reference to the image source." to "A reference to the image or data source."

related_jiras.note: Broadened DiagnosticReport.media wording to image-or-data and establishes the current wording that the media search parameter should match.
Audited later stale DiagnosticReport media/imaging wording and confirms current source should use media rather than image/imaging element terminology.
